name: Nocturnal Affair
source:
Three days has gone by since Sidney confronted his stalker.

Now, he can finally find himself a girlfriend just as planned and enjoy his college days without worries. Soon one of his college friends arrange him a blind date with a certain "Riley". With heart full of excitement he goes.

Much to his surprise a charming young man presents himself to Sidney instead.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250727083337/https://st-chem-atelier.itch.io/nocturnalaffairbl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
西德尼與跟蹤狂對峙後，已經過去三天。

現在，他終於可以按計畫找個女朋友，無憂無慮地享受大學生活。一名大學朋友很快替他安排了相親，對方名叫「萊利」。他滿懷期待地赴約。

令他驚訝的是，出現在西德尼面前的卻是一名迷人的年輕男性。

[來源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250727083337/https://st-chem-atelier.itch.io/nocturnalaffairbl]itch.io[/url]]
